sources.title: Introducing Muse Spark Open
sources.evidence: Announcement dated October 15, 2026 releases the weights that day. Describes native multimodality, coding and agentic work, nominal 816B total/42B active parameters, and the Muse Model License.

sources.title: Muse Spark Open model card and displayed license
sources.evidence: Model overview identifies Meta, October 15, 2026, 816B total/42B active, MoE Transformer with perception encoder, 256 experts with top-8 routing, and text/image/video/audio input with text output. Card describes additional safety post-training for this open release. The displayed license is version Muse Spark Open, with attribution, usage-policy and certain model-as-a-service conditions.

sources.title: Muse Spark Open overview
sources.evidence: Exact open variant: sparse MoE Transformer with built-in perception encoders, 816B total/42B active, 1,048,576-token context, four input modalities and text output. BF16 and NVFP4 are formats of this release.

sources.title: Meta model lineup
sources.evidence: Separately lists hosted Muse Spark 1.1, 1.2 and 1.3, and Muse Spark Open in the self-hosted/provider-hosted section. The Open model is not called through Meta Model API. Establishes Muse family membership without identifying Open with a particular closed revision.

sources.title: Official BF16 repository metadata
sources.evidence: At revision 0fb02478b02565b2ce7fc57e6051c91172774ac9, public metadata reports manual gating, MuseSparkForConditionalGeneration, 821,906,490,368 BF16 elements and 130,039,296 F32 elements: 822,036,529,664 aggregate. This is storage metadata, not a tensor-by-tensor learned-parameter audit.

sources.title: Official checkpoint configuration (access denied)
sources.evidence: Bounded unauthenticated request returned HTTP 401. The blob view also returned HTTP 401; exact checkpoint configuration could not be inspected.

sources.title: Muse Spark Open prompting guide
sources.evidence: Documents always-on reasoning with low/medium/high/xhigh effort, native function calls and parallel calls, and image/video/audio content parts for the exact released checkpoint. None/max are rejected effort values.

sources.title: Transformers Muse Spark configuration implementation
sources.evidence: Bounded source download inspected. Defaults: 62 text layers, 8192 hidden size, 256 routed experts/top-8, expert hidden and intermediate widths 4096, untied embeddings, and separate vision/audio configs. Defaults corroborate the model card but do not substitute for the inaccessible checkpoint config.

sources.title: Transformers Muse Spark model implementation
sources.evidence: Bounded source inspected: complete conditional generation model includes language model, vision tower, adapter/projection, audio tower and output head. MoE has shared pre/post expert projections around routed experts, with no separate shared-expert branch. Router correction bias is a buffer, demonstrating why aggregate tensor elements cannot automatically be called learned parameters.

sources.title: Official NVFP4 repository metadata
sources.evidence: Public metadata reports 483,807,947,264 aggregate stored elements, including U8 packed weights and F8_E4M3 scaling storage alongside BF16/F32. This lower storage aggregate is not a different learned-model parameter count.

sources.title: Official tensor index (access denied)
sources.evidence: Bounded request returned HTTP 401; tensor names and component decomposition could not be checked.

sources.title: Official first-shard header (access denied)
sources.evidence: Range request for bytes 0-7 returned HTTP 401. No weight data was downloaded.

developer.note: Meta Superintelligence Labs authors the model card; Meta is the normalized developer.

family.note: Catalog family normalization of the official Muse model lineup.

release_date.note: The dated announcement says the weights are released that day; repository creation is not public release.

open_weights.note: BF16 and NVFP4 checkpoints are released for download/self-hosting, subject to license and access conditions.

license.note: Verified in the publicly displayed license; this is a custom license, not an unrestricted open-source classification.

parameters_b.note: Nominal developer-published total in billions. The full architecture is multimodal, but exact component inclusion in 816B is unspecified. BF16 storage metadata totals 822.036529664B elements; gated config/index/header prevent reconciliation and exclusion of buffers. Do not replace the nominal count with that aggregate or add the encoder to it.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal published per-token active count, not an independently reconstructed multimodal phase count. Top-8 of 256 routed experts does not mean 816 × 8/256: shared projections, attention and other components also operate. Encoder/prefill versus text-decode counting conventions are not explicitly resolved.

architecture.note: Sparse MoE Transformer with a 62-layer language backbone plus vision and audio components. Implementation routes top-8 of 256 experts at width 4096, with shared pre/post projections but no separate shared-expert branch. Checkpoint config is inaccessible, so implementation defaults are corroboration, not a precise parameter audit.

context_window.note: Exact token limit from the open-model specification; 1M is the rounded marketing form.

modalities.note: All four input modalities and text-only output are explicitly documented for Open.

reasoning.note: Always-on reasoning; low, medium, high and xhigh are supported, with xhigh default.

tool_call.note: Native structured function calling and parallel tool calls are explicitly documented.

description.value: Muse Spark Open is Meta’s open-weight multimodal MoE Transformer, published as 816B total and 42B active parameters, for coding and agentic work with a 1,048,576-token context window.
description.note: Retains supported coding/agentic/multimodal/context claims and labels parameter figures as published counts.

patch.description: Muse Spark Open is Meta’s open-weight multimodal MoE Transformer, published as 816B total and 42B active parameters, for coding and agentic work with a 1,048,576-token context window.
patch.notes: 816B total and 42B active are Meta’s nominal published figures, not independently counted exact totals. BF16 repository metadata aggregates 822.036529664B stored tensor elements; its difference from the advertised 816B remains unreconciled because checkpoint config, tensor index and header access returned 401. The full released architecture includes language, vision and audio components; no verified component accounting establishes which are included in the nominal counts. Quantized storage elements, scale tensors and buffers are not automatically learned parameters. The 256 experts use top-8 routing; shared pre/post projections are not additional shared experts. This Open release is distinct from hosted Muse Spark 1.1, 1.2 and 1.3.

summary: Verified all 14 fields for the exact Open release. Fills nominal 816B total/42B active and MoE architecture from primary sources; qualifies description and records the unresolved advertised-total versus storage-aggregate discrepancy. Confirms October 15 release, custom Muse Model License, 1,048,576 context, four input modalities, text output, reasoning and tools. No weights downloaded; complete exact learned-parameter/component counting remains unverified due gated files.
